overall_diagnosis: Across samples, failures stem from quarter-scoping mismatches and broken/incomplete helper scripts. Multiple docs/examples don’t match the repo’s actual script locations and the dataset layout under /root/{quarter}/. Several scripts are syntactically truncated or contain malformed lists (missing commas), preventing execution. Even where runnable, key logic is wrong/underspecified: holding_analysis ignores the quarter argument and doesn’t output manager names; one_fund_analysis needs correct definitions for “number of stocks held” and a correct cross-quarter “Top Buys” calculation based on per-CUSIP VALUE deltas.

diagnosed_skills.diagnosis: Script appears syntactically broken (malformed title_class_of_stocks list due to missing commas; code truncated mid-statement) and likely miscomputes required metrics. It also needs correct quarter-scoped loading and correct cross-quarter Top Buys logic (VALUE deltas per CUSIP) plus an unambiguous “how many stocks held” metric.
diagnosed_skills.repair_instruction: Make the file runnable end-to-end: (1) fix title_class_of_stocks list by adding missing commas between every string; (2) repair any truncated/incomplete lines (e.g., AUM print) and ensure imports/entrypoint work. (3) Ensure data loads from /root/{quarter}/INFOTABLE.tsv using the provided quarter argument. (4) In single-quarter mode, compute and print: total rows/positions; AUM = sum(VALUE) for the accession_number; and “number of stocks held” as count of distinct CUSIP after optional equity filtering via TITLEOFCLASS (keep both raw and filtered counts if needed). (5) In comparison mode, load both quarters, aggregate VALUE by CUSIP (sum), outer-join, fill missing with 0, compute delta = target - baseline; rank positive deltas descending as Top Buys (and optionally negative as Top Sells); output top-k with CUSIP and delta.
